additional_sources.title: Hybrid Architectures for Language Models: Systematic Analysis and Design Insights
additional_sources.relevant_claim: from-scratch Transformer/Mamba ratio and early/middle/late placement ablations at 350M and 1B, plus attention-map and learned-mixture role analysis

new_overlap_decisions.reason: arXiv:2510.04800v3 trains early, scattered-middle, and later Transformer/Mamba layouts from scratch at 350M and 1B across 1:1, 1:3, 1:5, and 1:12 ratios
the placement tables directly show worse validation NLL for front or layer-1 attention and recommend middle or later scattered attention
the paper attributes early-layer failure to nearly uniform Transformer attention conflicting with Mamba locality and observes learned mixtures favor Mamba early and Transformer in the middle
the paper jointly studies attention-to-Mamba ratio and placement, recommending 1:1 for quality and about 1:5 for efficiency-quality balance

residual_assessment.distinction: the source does not freeze a predictor on discovery layouts or test prospective rank and calibrated failure-margin prediction on arbitrary unseen layouts across tasks, scales, and mixers
residual_assessment.burden: must outperform the new source's middle/later recipe plus ratio, role, probe, sensitivity, greedy-conversion, joint-gate, and random-layout baselines without observing held-out layout outcomes
residual_assessment.scientific_value: not established; predictive success, causal validity, and a resulting architecture improvement are all currently absent

source_limitations: multi-attention layouts are a small hand-designed family rather than an arbitrary combinatorial placement space
the reviewed text reports no placement seeds, replicates, uncertainty intervals, or frozen prospective predictions
mechanism evidence is qualitative or observational rather than a fixed-budget causal restoration
placement results cover base Transformer and Mamba 2 at 350M and 1B
the arXiv record declares no official code, model, configuration, or immutable data-order artifact

priority.n1: continue landscape, artifact, patent, deployed-system, and independent expert review only; do not authorize placement experiments
priority.baseline_proxy: complete independently because it evaluates the conservative parent rather than either novelty claim

decision.next_action: finish the frozen proxy and complete independent claim review plus remaining patent and deployed-system search before deciding whether prospective placement prediction has enough incremental value to retain
